ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Sun and Uranus

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, family and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The sextile between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, money and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.
